annotations.title: Find artworks, artists, museums and articles by name or keywords

description: Keyword search of the FOUR models in one call: artworks, artists, museums and articles (maximum 10 results per model, merged by relevance; each result names its model). It is the first search to try when you have a name or keywords and do not know which kind of object they name ("Monet", "Orsay", "Water Lilies"). It has no filter: once you know the model, search_artworks / search_artists / search_museums / search_articles search that model alone, with its filters (city, country, year alive, category). It matches WORDS: for a sentence or a paragraph without a name, use search_objects_semantically (the objects a text is about) or search_sections_semantically (the passages that answer a question). Each result carries pk, model, title, artist_name, city, country, date_born, date_death, url, image_url (absolute URL of the large image, null when there is none), meta_description and score.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

query.description: Words to search across all four catalogs.
